APPROVED RAIL CONVERTER ENGINEERING REFERENCE, item25, 2026-10-18. ABB2024 ACS6080 PEP ABBG-00712-V01.01-EN, marked Draft/Public, page7, https://library.e.abb.com/public/f0dd73990f0242ab9a0e88dbf6090edd/PEP_EPD_ACS6080_33AXD10002395301_RevA_EN_05122024.pdf; ABB BORDLINE masses/power retained from existing rail sources. Infineon FZ1500R33HE3 datasheet construction reference https://www.infineon.com/assets/row/public/documents/60/49/infineon-fz1500r33he3-datasheet-en.pdf. Replace the mass-scaled4.5kg car battery-voltage converter with an explicit medium-voltage AC-drive-based reference, not a measured BORDLINE BOM. ABB2024 draft PEP gives14583kg including packaging:steel43.4%,Cu20.4%,Al2.25%,GFRP1.7%,otherplastics0.4%,electroniccomponents12.9%,wood13.7%,other5.25%. Percentages sum100. Treat wood as packaging and exclude it from installed reference mass:hardware fraction0.863. Perkg installed converter divide other category fractions by0.863; purchase packaging wood0.137/0.863kg additionally. Source is an18MW industrial AC drive, not a rail-qualified product: composition transfer to BORDLINE is an explicit engineering analogue, with source installed masses and power/lifetime counts unchanged. Assume electronic component mass70%film capacitors,25%power semiconductor modules,5%populated control boards. These fractions are design assumptions; sensitivity capacitor50-80%, module10-40%, board2-10%, constrained to100%. Generic Pb-free through-hole board retains upstream precious metals; no zero-gold assumption. Illustrative power module retained recipe:Cu50%,Al10%,alumina20%,PPS10%,silicone8%,silicon die2%. Represent die fabrication by existing fabricated-IC-wafer service using300um silicon thickness and2330kg/m3 density:0.02/(2330*0.0003)m2/kgmodule. This wafer and power-module composition are engineering proxies, not Infineon material declarations or verified rail die technology. Module assembly1kWh/kg assumed. Film capacitor proxy includes its own constituent materials once. Other5.25%/0.863=6.08343% installed hardware mass remains compositionally UNRESOLVED and is not silently converted into zero metal or an arbitrary PCB. Known retained material coverage93.91657%; trace-metal completeness is not claimed.100%retention reference plus generic metal-working/1kWh final assembly perkg; yields, cooling coolant, additional cabling, end-of-life and rail qualification remain gaps. Do not infer corrected system gold totals before rebuilding and sensitivity analysis. No passenger/freight service denominator change in this commit.

Source rights and permission to release all cited material remain unverified; no restricted process inventories copied. Current PSI equivalence, connected 3.12 exports, protected PV closure and export/restore validation required before release.

Infineon identifies an AlSiC base plate and AlN substrate; this recipe's aluminium/alumina fractions are not that construction. No unsupported AlN or AlSiC mass is inferred from a construction label. Native270um reference mass-equivalence is not proof of finished die thickness, IGBT fab technology or yield. Native upstream fabrication/yields remain once; do not add raw Si, another yield multiplier or a complete packaged IC.
